# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD decision files the content audit found missing.

dod_form_china_manchu = {
	is_shown = {
		c:MCK ?= this
		NOT = { exists = c:CHI }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_asi_china }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		any_scope_state = { count >= 12 state_region = { is_homeland = cu:han } }
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_asi_china
		change_tag = CHI
		add_modifier = { name = dod_asi_mandate_of_heaven months = 120 }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 80 }
}

dod_treaty_of_batavia = {
	is_shown = {
		c:JAV ?= this
		exists = c:BRG
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_asi_batavia }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_WEST_JAVA
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_asi_batavia
		c:BRG = { trigger_event = { id = dod_asm.1 days = 7 } }
		change_relations = { country = c:BRG value = 20 }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 50 }
}

dod_clm_controlled_dissolution = {
	is_shown = {
		c:CLM ?= this
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_clm_dissolved }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		NOT = { country_rank >= rank_value:great_power }
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_clm_dissolved
		add_modifier = { name = dod_clm_dissolution months = 120 }
		dod_release_homeland = { TAG = MEX CULTURE = mexican }
		dod_release_homeland = { TAG = QUI CULTURE = ecuadorian }
		c:GRA ?= { trigger_event = { id = dod_asm.2 days = 30 } }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 5 }
}
